<p style="margin: 0px 0pt; text-align: right; font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Exhibit 99.1</b></font></p>

<p style="margin: 0px 0pt; text-align: left; font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: right; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt;"><img alt="logo01.jpg" src="logo01.jpg"></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 14pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: center;"><br>
<b>Usio Announces First&nbsp;Quarter&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667217498304">2026</a>&nbsp;Financial Results</b></p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 14pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: center;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 14pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: center;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 12pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: center; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">Revenue Up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x4" data-tblname="128743" data-tblv="16" id="led128743F20264111778502586684">16%</a>, Beats Consensus by 9%</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 12pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: center; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 12pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: center; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">Adjusted EBITDA<sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">1</sup> of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="128747" data-tblv="16" id="led128747F20264111778502604362">$0.8</a>&nbsp;Million Beats Consensus by 12%</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 14pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: center;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: center; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;"><i>All-time Record Quarterly Revenue, Processing Volume and Transactions</i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:center;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;"><i>Total payment dollars processed through all payment channels up <a data-tblloc="12x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20249241729770375162">28%</a>&nbsp;versus the prior year period</i>&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:12pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:center;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 14pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: center;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">SAN ANTONIO, May 13, <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>&nbsp;(GLOBE NEWSWIRE) &#8211; Usio, Inc., "Usio" or the "Company"&nbsp;(Nasdaq: USIO), a leading FinTech company&nbsp;that operates a full stack of integrated, cloud-based electronic payment and embedded financial solutions, today announced financial results for the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667218784763">first</a>&nbsp;quarter&nbsp;ended <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667218799775">March 31, 2026</a>.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Louis Hoch, President and Chief Executive Officer of Usio, said,&nbsp;&#8220;It was a record start to the new year, affirming our belief that the momentum coming out of our record <a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20259281761652510184">2025</a> would provide a strong tailwind for continued growth and profitability.&nbsp;All of our key performance metrics were at record levels in the first quarter, with revenues up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x4" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20264111778499697479">16%</a>, the fastest rate of revenue growth in nine quarters.&nbsp;Total processing volume and transactions also set new records, which is an impressive encore to the prior quarter where we set many of the previous all-time records.&nbsp;The strength of our business is broad based, with better than 20% growth in ACH and&nbsp;credit card, and nearly the same in Output Solutions, which was up <a data-tblloc="5x4" data-tblname="64716" data-tblv="16" id="led64716F20264111778499854290">19%</a>.&nbsp;This strong growth, coupled with our fiscal discipline, led to a significant year-over-year improvement in the bottom line as well as positive operating cash flow, and a further improvement in our balance sheet and liquidity.&nbsp;The implementation of our Usio One strategy, our growing reputation in the payments industry, and the innovative technologies integrated into our diversified businesses are increasingly taking hold, providing us with confidence in our expectation of achieving another year of profitable, double-digit growth in fiscal 2026.&#8221;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Results in the first quarter were led by a&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="3x3" data-tblname="64716" data-tblv="16" id="led64716F20264111778499939493">$1.8</a> million, or&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="3x4" data-tblname="64716" data-tblv="16" id="led64716F20264111778499944735">23%</a>, increase in credit card revenues.&nbsp;Volumes were up strongly, with dollars processed up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20233281682686143924">16%</a> and transactions processed&nbsp;up <a data-tblloc="3x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20233281682686149539">22%</a> from a year ago. Credit card results increasingly reflect the strength of our PayFac business, which now accounts for nearly 80% of total credit card segment revenues, and has consistently grown revenues at double digit rates.&nbsp;We expect this to be the new growth trajectory of our credit card business.&nbsp;ACH, our highest margin business, had another record quarter with strong volumes driving revenues up <a data-tblloc="2x4" data-tblname="64716" data-tblv="16" id="led64716F20264111778500247721">25%</a>. ACH revenue growth was primarily attributable to an increase in ACH and PINLess debit volume from net, new business and organic growth.&nbsp;ACH set new processing volume records with electronic check dollar&nbsp;volume increasing&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="6x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20233281682686188862">31%</a>, transactions growing&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20233281682686181716">34%</a> and returned check transactions up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20233281682686195815">54%</a>, all as compared to the same period last year. PINless debit also set quarterly all-time records as transactions and dollars processed were up 23% and 36%, respectively, from the same period a year ago,&nbsp;driven by growth in the mortgage servicing and fintech industries.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Output Solutions generated accelerating revenue growth, with revenues up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x4" data-tblname="64716" data-tblv="16" id="led64716F20264111778500317494">19%</a> in the quarter, a strong sequential improvement from the previous quarter&#8217;s 8% growth. Volumes were at record levels with highly profitable electronic documents processed and delivered up 41% for the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667218784763">first</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a> compared to the same quarter of <a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20259281761652510184">2025</a>.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">For the quarter, gross profits were up over 6%, although gross margins were somewhat softer in the quarter, primarily attributable to a decrease in interest revenue (which has a 100% margin) and revenue mix.&nbsp;Margins are expected to improve over the balance of the year.&nbsp;Total selling, general and administrative expenses,&nbsp;inclusive of depreciation and amortization and stock-based compensation ("Total SG&amp;A Expenses"),&nbsp;were down over $130,000 from the year ago period, although the line item "SG&amp;A," consisting of selling, general and administrative expenses only,&nbsp;was up modestly from the year ago quarter.&nbsp;On a sequential basis, SG&amp;A was reduced by $700,000 and is now at a level that is not expected to materially increase this year.&nbsp;For the quarter ended <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2025711754077622272">March 31, 2026</a>, the Company reported net income of approximately&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="12x1" data-tblname="128743" data-tblv="16" id="led128743F20264111778500787276">$0.1</a> million, or&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="128743" data-tblv="16" id="led128743F20264111778500802932">$0.00</a>&nbsp;per share, compared to a net loss of (<a data-tblloc="12x2" data-tblname="128743" data-tblv="16" id="led128743F20264111778500826380">$0.2</a>) million, or (<a data-tblloc="14x2" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20264111778500894919">$0.01</a>) per share, for the first quarter of <a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2026441777896755185">2025</a>. Note that there were no extraordinary items that contributed to the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667218784763">first</a> quarter <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>&nbsp;net income as calculated in accordance with the United States generally accepted accounting principles ("GAAP").&nbsp;Adjusted EBITDA<sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">1</sup>&nbsp;was&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="128747" data-tblv="16" id="led128747F20264111778500961816">$0.8</a> million for the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667218784763">first</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, up compared to&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x2" data-tblname="128747" data-tblv="16" id="led128747F20264111778500969542">$0.7</a> million in the same quarter a year ago. Operating cash flow for the quarter was <a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="64713" data-tblv="16" id="led64713F20264111778501007850">$0.9</a>&nbsp;million, representing the continued strength of our business.&nbsp;The Company used approximately $235,000 to repurchase 182,000 shares of its common stock.&nbsp;Cash increased <a data-tblloc="5x3" data-tblname="64712" data-tblv="16" id="led64712F20264111778501067575">$0.3</a>&nbsp;million over the quarter and was in excess of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64712" data-tblv="16" id="led64712F20264111778501060037">$7.7</a> million at <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20264111778520969208">March 31, 2026</a>.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><b><u>Quarterly Processing and Transaction Volumes</u></b></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Total payment dollars processed through all payment channels in the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">first</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a> were&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="10x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F2024771723062386146">$2.50</a> billion, an improvement of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="12x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F2024771723062368254">28%</a> over the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="10x2" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F2024771723062396886">$1.96</a> billion processed in last year's <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">first</a> quarter.&nbsp;Total payment transactions processed in the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">first</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>&nbsp;were 16.8 million, an increase&nbsp;of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="3x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20264111778502755096">22%</a> over the same quarter of last year.&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Our credit card segment continues to grow, where dollars processed were up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20233281682686143924">16%</a> and transactions processed were up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="3x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20233281682686149539">22%</a> from a year ago. In the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">first</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, ACH electronic check transaction volume was&nbsp;up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20233281682686181716">34%</a>, electronic check dollars processed were up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="6x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20233281682686188862">31%</a> and return check transactions processed were up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20233281682686195815">54%</a>, in each case, compared to the same quarter of <a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2026441777896755185">2025</a>. In our&nbsp;prepaid card services business unit,&nbsp;card load volume was down&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="7x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20233281682686156053">19%</a>, transactions processed&nbsp;down&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="8x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20233281682686164394">16%</a> and purchase volume&nbsp;down&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="9x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20233281682686172563">7%</a>&nbsp;for the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667218784763">first</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, in each case, compared to the same quarter of <a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20259281761652517712">2025</a>.&nbsp;Output Solutions pieces processed and mailed were up 31% while electronic documents processed and delivered were up 41% for the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667218784763">first</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, in each case, compared to the same quarter of <a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20259281761652517712">2025</a>.</p>

<p style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><u><b><a data-tblloc="44x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667217657196">First</a>&nbsp;Quarter&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667217666159">2026</a>&nbsp;Revenue Detail</b></u></p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">Revenues for the quarter ended&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667217678779">March 31, 2026</a>&nbsp;were&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20229311667217706070">$25.5</a>&nbsp;million, up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x4" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20264111778499697479">16%</a> from&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x2" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20251061762436943817">$22.0</a>&nbsp;million in the prior year quarter, due primarily to increases in all of our business lines, excluding prepaid card services and interest revenues.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

			<td id=".amt.3" style="width: 9%; text-align: right; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 0pt; border-bottom: 3px double rgb(0, 0, 0);">22,009,050</td>
			<td id=".trail.3" nowrap="true" style="width: 1%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 0pt; padding-bottom: 3px;">&nbsp;</td>
			<td id=".lead.4" style="width: 1%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; padding-bottom: 3px;">&nbsp;</td>
			<td id=".symb.4" style="width: 1%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 0pt; border-bottom: 3px double rgb(0, 0, 0);">$</td>
			<td id=".amt.4" style="width: 9%; text-align: right; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 0pt; border-bottom: 3px double rgb(0, 0, 0);">3,456,724</td>
			<td id=".trail.4" nowrap="true" style="width: 1%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 0pt; padding-bottom: 3px;">&nbsp;</td>
			<td id=".lead.5" style="width: 1%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; padding-bottom: 3px;">&nbsp;</td>
			<td id=".symb.5" style="width: 1%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; border-bottom: 3px double rgb(0, 0, 0);">&nbsp;</td>
			<td id=".amt.5" style="width: 9%; text-align: right; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 0pt; border-bottom: 3px double rgb(0, 0, 0);">16</td>
			<td id=".trail.5" nowrap="true" style="width: 1%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin-left: 0pt; padding-bottom: 3px;">%</td>
		</tr>

</table>

<p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">Gross profit&nbsp;for the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">first</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a> was&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x1" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20229311667217861249">$5.1</a>&nbsp;million, up versus&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x2" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F2026441777896860687">$4.8</a> million in the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">first</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686978409">2025</a>. Gross margins (defined as gross profit as a percentage of revenues)&nbsp;were&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20229311667217868890">20.2%</a>&nbsp;in&nbsp;the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">first</a> quarter of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, down versus&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x2" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F2026441777896904375">21.9%</a>&nbsp;in <a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20251061762437050109">2025</a>. This was&nbsp;primarily due to lower interest revenues, a high margin revenue source, and revenue mix.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">Total SG&amp;A Expenses for the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">first</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, were&nbsp;$4.9 million, down from over $5.0 million in the year ago quarter primarily due to lower depreciation&nbsp;and amortization&nbsp;and stock-based&nbsp;compensation expense.&nbsp;SG&amp;A was&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="128743" data-tblv="16" id="led128743F20264111778501306927">$4.4</a> million for the quarter ended March 31, 2026,&nbsp;compared to&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x2" data-tblname="128743" data-tblv="16" id="led128743F20264111778501313677">$4.1</a> million in the prior year period. This increase was primarily related to increases in salary&nbsp;alongside&nbsp;increases in network infrastructure&nbsp;and&nbsp;professional fees.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">For the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">first</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, we reported&nbsp;operating income of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="9x1" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20236311690828878985">$0.2</a>&nbsp;million&nbsp;compared to an operating loss of (<a data-tblloc="9x2" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F2024721722602768544">$0.2</a>) million for the same quarter a year ago primarily due to increased revenues and gross profits, alongside a decrease in Total SG&amp;A Expenses. Adjusted EBITDA<sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">1</sup>&nbsp;was&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="16x1" data-tblname="128743" data-tblv="16" id="led128743F20229311667217955432">$0.8</a>&nbsp;million for the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">first</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, compared to&nbsp;Adjusted EBITDA<sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">1</sup>&nbsp;of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="17x2" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F2024491715262601824">$0.7</a>&nbsp;million for the same quarter a year ago. Net income in&nbsp;the quarter ended&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20237101691688231954">March 31, 2026</a>&nbsp;was approximately <a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20236311690828900390">$0.1</a>&nbsp;million, or <a data-tblloc="14x1" data-tblname="128743" data-tblv="16" id="led128743F20229311667218004520">$0.00</a>&nbsp;per share, compared to a net loss of (<a data-tblloc="13x2" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F2024721722602807883">$0.2</a>) million, or (<a data-tblloc="14x2" data-tblname="128743" data-tblv="16" id="led128743F20229311667218064431">$0.01</a>) per share,&nbsp;for the same period in the prior year.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">Operating Cash Flows&nbsp;declined to&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="64713" data-tblv="16" id="led64713F20229311667218268164">$0.9</a>&nbsp;million for the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="64488" data-tblv="16" id="led64488F20229311667218235799">three months ended March 31, 2026</a>, as compared to <a data-tblloc="2x2" data-tblname="64713" data-tblv="16" id="led64713F20229311667218356250">$1.4</a>&nbsp;million in the same period a year ago. The year ago period benefited from an approximately $1.5 million tax refund. Additionally,&nbsp;prepaid expenses and accounts receivable <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64488" data-tblv="16" id="led64488F20229311667218448700">March 31, 2026</a> were up as compared to December 31, 2025.</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">We believe we continue&nbsp;to be in solid financial condition.&nbsp;Cash and cash equivalents as of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64488" data-tblv="16" id="led64488F20229311667218448700">March 31, 2026</a>&nbsp;were <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64712" data-tblv="16" id="led64712F20229311667218437285">$7.7</a> million, a&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x3" data-tblname="64712" data-tblv="16" id="led64712F20233281682685994931">$0.3</a> million increase over cash and cash equivalents as of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="25x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20264111778521304283">December 31, 2025</a>, even after the use of over $230,000&nbsp;to repurchase 182,000 shares of our common stock during the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">first</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>.</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><u><b>Conference Call and Webcast</b></u></p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Usio's management will host a conference call on Wednesday, May 13, <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, at 4:30 pm Eastern time&nbsp;to review financial results and provide a business update.&nbsp;To listen to the conference call, interested parties within the&nbsp;U.S.&nbsp;should call +1-844-833-3890. International callers should call&nbsp;+&nbsp;1-412-317-9246. All callers should ask for the Usio conference call. The conference call will also be available through a live webcast, which can be accessed via the Company&#8217;s website at&nbsp;www.usio.com/investors.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">A replay of the call will be available approximately one hour after the end of the call through June 13, <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>. The replay can be accessed via the Company&#8217;s website or by dialing 1-855-669-9658 (U.S.) or&nbsp;1-412-317-0088&nbsp;(international). The replay conference playback code is 4785914.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><u><b>About Usio, Inc.</b></u></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Usio, Inc.&nbsp;(Nasdaq:&nbsp;USIO), a leading, cloud-based, integrated FinTech electronic payment solutions provider, offers a wide range of payment solutions to merchants, billers, banks, service bureaus, integrated software vendors and card issuers. The Company operates credit, debit/prepaid, and ACH payment processing platforms to deliver convenient, world-class payment solutions and services to clients through its unique payment facilitation platform as a service. The Company, through its Usio Output Solutions division, offers services relating to electronic bill presentment, document composition, document decomposition and printing and mailing services. The strength of the Company lies in its ability to provide tailored solutions for card issuance, payment acceptance, and bill payments as well as its unique technology in the card issuing sector.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">Usio&nbsp;is headquartered in&nbsp;San Antonio, Texas, and has offices in&nbsp;Austin, Texas. Websites:&nbsp;www.usio.com&nbsp;and&nbsp;www.akimbocard.com.&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">Find us on LinkedIn, Facebook&#174; and Twitter.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><u><b>Comparisons</b></u></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Unless otherwise indicated, all comparisons and growth rates represent year-over-year comparisons, with the quarterly period of this year compared to the corresponding quarter of the prior year.</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><u><b>About Non-GAAP Financial Measures</b></u></p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">This press release&nbsp;includes the non-GAAP financial measures, as defined in Regulation G adopted by the Securities and Exchange Commission, of EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA, and Adjusted EBITDA margins. The Company reports its financial results in compliance with GAAP, but believes that also discussing non-GAAP financial measures is useful to investors because it provides them with financial measures the Company uses in the management of its business.</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; width: 100%;">

		<tr>
			<td style="width: 29px; padding: 0px; text-align: center; vertical-align: top;">&#8226;</td>
			<td style="width: 1687px;">The Company defines EBITDA as operating income (loss), before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization of intangibles.</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td style="width: 29px; padding: 0px; text-align: center; vertical-align: top;">&#8226;</td>
			<td style="width: 1687px;">The Company defines Adjusted EBITDA as EBITDA, as defined above, plus non-cash stock-based compensation and certain non-recurring items, such as costs related to acquisitions.</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td style="width: 29px; padding: 0px; text-align: center; vertical-align: top;">&#8226;</td>
			<td style="width: 1687px;">The Company defines Adjusted EBITDA margins as Adjusted EBITDA, as defined above, divided by total revenues.</td>
		</tr>

</table>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Management believes presenting EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA, and Adjusted EBITDA margins&nbsp;is helpful to investors in evaluating the Company's operating performance because non-cash costs and other items that management believes are not indicative of its results of operations are excluded.&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt;">EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA, and Adjusted EBITDA margins should be considered in addition to, not as a substitute for, or superior to, financial measures calculated in accordance with GAAP.&nbsp;They are not&nbsp;measurements of our financial performance under GAAP and should not be considered as alternatives to revenue,&nbsp;net income, or cash provided by (used in) operating activities, or any other performance measures derived in accordance with GAAP and may not be comparable to other similarly titled measures of other businesses. EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA, and Adjusted EBITDA margins have&nbsp;limitations as analytical tools and you should not consider these non-GAAP financial measures in isolation or as&nbsp;substitutes for analysis of our operating results as reported under GAAP.</p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</p>
